plain_summary_en: This paper studies Toward Epistemic Resilience: Reimagining Visual Journalism Through Continuity. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is visual journalism, epistemic resilience, continuity, future of journalism. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
